title: Amphiprion frenatus aggressive sounds - journal.pone.0049179.s001
author: Colleye O, Parmentier E (2012)
changes: Tomato clownfish (Amphiprion frenatus), a close relative of the orange clownfish, making a series of popping sounds while chasing another clownfish, recorded underwater in the wild by researchers. Trimmed to 1.15–2.42 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of the video; a steady background hum stays about 20 dB below the pops.
